meta.target: 24h SWE (mm): SNOTEL gain over the PST day; CoCoRaHS new-snow SWE over the morning-to-morning window
meta.bboxFormat: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat]; first match in 'order' wins

historical.criterion: per model on the 2024-25 overlap: >= 50 matched wet days, |bias_hist/bias_prev - 1| <= 0.1, |mae_hist/mae_prev - 1| <= 0.15

meta.aliasNote: aliases[model][lead] = model whose forecast it duplicates; use that entry and don't count both
meta.fallback: missing region/band -> 'ALL'; missing model or lead -> app heuristic

snowRatio.definition: NewSnowDepth / NewSnowSWE (in/in) on reports with >= 1 in new snow and >= 0.10 in SWE
snowRatio.tempSource: lead-1 model-mean 2 m temperature over the report's 24h window, F; band = [lo, hi)
